newsitem.title: UK: Goldman notes strong demand for BP shares.
newsitem.headline: Goldman notes strong demand for BP shares.

text.p: Investment bank Goldman Sachs said on Thursday it noted "substantial" demand for the 170 million shares in British Petroleum Co Plc put on offer by the Kuwait Investment Office.
"All that I can tell you is that there has been very substantial demand, both from institutions and individuals," a Goldman spokesman told Reuters.
He added that demand was spread between the United States, Continental Europe, the UK and the Far East.
He declined to say whether all shares had already been sold. Goldman would probably give further comment later today, he added.
The sale of the 170 million shares, representing 3.0 percent of BP, was announced late on Wednesday. The Kuwait Investment Office said it would continue to hold about 6.3 percent of BP.

It called the stake sale a "rebalancing" exercise. The move failed to upset industry analysts. "The fact somebody sells shares does not change the fundamentals of the company," said Paul Spedding at Kleinwort Benson.
Shares in BP were down 13-1/2 pence at 731 by 0856 GMT.
